name: WA-10
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 9-point Democratic lean plus favorable national environment
Strickland's incumbency and $1.5M raised versus a lightly funded challenger
Prediction markets price her near 94% to win
No public polling of the general election
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Strickland: a D+9 district, a pro-Democratic environment, incumbency, and a large fundraising edge over Chris Chung, with markets pricing her around 94%. With no polls or expert ratings available, the forecast stays close to the fundamentals, keeping modest uncertainty.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a single-digit race, or a surge of outside spending for Chung, would warrant moving this toward Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Marilyn Strickland, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a Tacoma-area district that leans Democratic by about nine points. She has raised roughly $1.5 million and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Chris Chung has reported little fundraising and draws no outside support. Prediction markets give Strickland about a 94% chance of winning.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district lean, the national environment, incumbency, and money. All of these favor Strickland, pointing to a comfortable double-digit win, though the absence of polling leaves some room for error.
